## The finding

`onUploadingChange` has exactly **one** consumer, `ActionParamDialog`. The `@object-ui/plugin-form` record-form chain does not read it.

⇒ a record form can be **submitted while an upload is still in flight**. Pressing Save immediately after picking a file writes the record **without the attachment** — and reports success.

## Why it is worse than a race

⭐ The user did everything right: they picked the file, they saw it listed, they saved. There is no error, no warning, and the record looks saved. The attachment is simply not there. ⚠️ Whoever notices does so later, looking at a record that should have a file and does not — by which time the cause is invisible.

⛔ Not touched by PR objectui#10165: the plugin-form files were declared hands-off that round (they were in flight on PR objectui#10161).

## Step 1 for whoever takes it

Reproduce as a **difference**, not an absence: a save issued while an upload is pending versus the same save after it resolves, asserting the stored value — ⛔ a pin that only checks 「no error」 passes on exactly the defect.

## Dedupe words

`onUploadingChange ObjectForm submit in-flight upload` · `record form saves without attachment` · `upload pending Save race plugin-form` · `objectui#10131 sibling`
